suite.name: Public-RWS-18
suite.description: External validation suite for ProCARE profile-IR-certificate transfer on three public health datasets.

source.export_note: Extracted from the Public-RWS-18 prompt listing in the ProCARE appendix.

prompt_levels.name: Low
prompt_levels.description: Low-specificity task objective; system must discover feasible variables and limitations.

prompt_levels.name: Medium
prompt_levels.description: Medium-specificity prompt with approach-level table or variable guidance.

prompt_levels.name: High
prompt_levels.description: High-specificity prompt with concrete fields, outputs, and claim-scope constraints.

datasets.name: UCI Diabetes
datasets.structure: 101,766 encounters, 50 columns; department-split workbook is used only as a sheet-navigation variant.
datasets.task_focus: Readmission proxy, medication process, utilization, coded variables, missingness.
datasets.boundary: Encounter-level data with limited longitudinal structure.
datasets.forbidden_claims: Causal treatment effect, safety conclusion, longitudinal endpoint claim.

datasets.name: NHANES
datasets.structure: 10 linked XPT/CSV tables with 3,036-19,643 rows per table, linked by SEQN.
datasets.task_focus: Survey cohort construction, labs, medications, conditions, demographic covariates.
datasets.forbidden_claims: Temporal effect, incidence claim, causal effect.

datasets.name: TCGA-LIHC
datasets.task_focus: HCC metadata, vital status, treatment fields, follow-up proxy fields.
datasets.boundary: Cancer registry-like clinical metadata, not routine-care EHR.
datasets.allowed_claims: Descriptive oncology metadata and follow-up-proxy claims.
datasets.forbidden_claims: Treatment efficacy, causal survival effect, routine-care EHR claim.
